cases.disposition_reason: --page diskcleanup opens Screens › Disk cleanup on the Playground. The sidebar label Disk cleanup is in Screens and left of column 24. From Finder, ] enters Disk cleanup and [ returns to Finder. Another ] reaches Activity. Clicking Overview leaves the page, and clicking Disk cleanup returns.
cases.label: Disk cleanup
cases.return_path: sidebar selection returns to Overview and keyboard [ ] can leave and re-enter the route

cases.disposition_reason: The Playground shows the usage tree with sizes, filesystem line meters, and four checked categories: Xcode DerivedData, Xcode device support, Simulator caches, and Cargo registry cache. Docker build cache stays unchecked because Docker is running.
The Playground at 120 by 40 shows the live widget caption, the full blurb, and the truecolor 120×40 chip above the filesystems, usage tree, and cleanup checklist.
cases.expected_results: The Disk cleanup playground section is the visible section at 120 by 40.
cases.forbidden_effects: A different section's caption is the active caption.
cases.action_sequence: Launch showcase --page diskcleanup --motion paused at 120x40 and activate the playground tab.

cases.disposition_reason: Compare levels reached no color at 120 by 40 after 256 colors and 16 colors. The settled 80 by 24 frame still showed no color, and that narrow frame was captured before the terminal grew back. Turning Compare levels off left the seven options at their defaults.
cases.action_sequence: Turn Compare levels on, scroll the bands, narrow the terminal, then turn Compare levels off.
cases.expected_results: Colour bands for the supported levels are visible, and the page state is unchanged after return.
cases.forbidden_effects: Leaving Compare levels changes the selected page or an option value.

cases.disposition_reason: diskcleanup.mode=permanent shows permanent delete and review, then type DEL. Gate 1 is Review · 4 categories · gate 1 of 2 with Delete permanently 4 categories and rm -rf. Gate 2 is Delete permanently · gate 2 of 2 and asks for DELETE 4. Cancel leaves the four categories and says Cleanup cancelled · nothing changed.
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set diskcleanup.mode from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: The visible Mode effect matches the selected value.

cases.disposition_reason: Review deletion with the four checked categories opens Review · 4 categories · gate 1 of 2, primary Continue…. Continue opens Move to Trash · gate 2 of 2 and asks for TRASH 4. TRASH 9 stays in the field and does not commit. Cancel says Cleanup cancelled · nothing changed and leaves the categories. A paused Rescan shows scanning · 5 left and does not say Scan complete. An empty selection says Select a category first (Space) and opens no dialog. Dry run is one dialog, Dry run · 4 categories, with Run dry run, and the status says the bytes would be freed without removing rows. Confirming TRASH 4 removes the four checked rows and says Moved 4 categories to the Trash.
cases.action_sequence: Rescan, select targets, dry-run, and pass both confirmation stages with a wrong phrase and the exact phrase.
cases.expected_results: The wrong phrase does not remove items. The exact phrase removes only the selected demonstration items.
cases.forbidden_effects: Dry run deletes a demonstration item.
